name: Xbox Sales Dashboard
tagline: Excel VBA macro that builds a one-page sales dashboard from raw data with one click.
description: VBA macro for Microsoft Excel that generates a one-page sales dashboard with slicers, KPI cards and charts in dark mode.
features: One macro run (Alt+F11, then F5) creates the dashboard in a new sheet.
Slicers for Plan, Renewal and Type filter all visuals together.
KPI cards use IFERROR(GETPIVOTDATA(...), 0), so empty filters show 0, not #REF!.
